title: Ennyonyi Okusomoka Ennyanja Etateredde
intro: Kuba ekifaananyi ng’oyimiridde ku ddeeke y’eryato eritisse omugugu ng’amayengo gakulukuta era ng’abakozi bakuba akalulu okukendeeza ku mugugu. Ekifaananyi ekitali kimu kigenda mu maaso, ng’akkiriza enkomerero eringa enkomerero, obuziba bwokka ne bufuuka ekifo eky’okusaba n’okudda. Emabega waliwo ekitundu ekirabuddwa ku kibonerezo ekijja, mu maaso waliwo okusaasira okutasuubirwa.
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omubaka eri abantu abasukka mu kakadde.
Abantu bange naleka mu busungu nga sinnafuna lukusa kuvaawo.
Nalinnya emmeeri eyali etisse emigugu era abakozi ne bakuba akalulu okusalawo ani agenda okusuulibwa mu nnyanja.
Nasuulibwa mu nnyanja ne nmira ekyennyanja ekinene nga nze nvunaanibwa.
Nagulumiza Allah mu bizikiza, nga nlangirira nti tewali musambwa okuggyako Ye era nti mbadde ku basobya.
Nasuulibwa ku lubalama oluggule, nga ndi mulwadde, era Allah n’aleetera ekimera ky’entungo okumera waggulu wange, olwo abantu bange ne bakkiriza ne baweebwa okunyumirwa okumala ekiseera.

trial.label: Kigezo ki kye Nnayolekagana nabyo?
options: Okusuulibwa mu muliro kyakolebwa nga kiyonjo era nga tekirina bulabe
Basuulibwa mu luzzi oluwanvu ab’oluganda abalina obuggya
Yakubwa obulwadde okumala ebbanga n’okufiirwa obulamu

outcome.label: Kiki Ekyavaamu?
options: Yalokoka olw’okugulumizibwa era abantu bange ne bakkiriza ne bawonyezebwa okumala akaseera
Abantu bange baafuulibwa enkima olw’okumenya Ssabbiiti
Abantu bange baakwatibwa okubwatuka okw’amaanyi okuva mu bbanga
Abantu bange baabbira mu mazzi amataba amanene
outcome.answer: Yalokoka olw’okugulumizibwa era abantu bange ne bakkiriza ne bawonyezebwa okumala akaseera

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
